concept.title: A football club for my child after school
concept.shortdesc: As a parent of an 11-year-old, I need to find a football club in my area that runs after school on weekdays, so that my child has structured activity and I can manage busy evenings.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-006). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Ten minutes at lunchtime on a phone; wants an answer without forms.
A good result: Clubs that take his age, with days, times, cost and a contact, ranked by distance.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: Find me a football club for my lad, he's 11, in south Leeds, preferably after school on weekdays.
youth football training on a weeknight
